—2 The plant Semecarpus Anacardium (भल्लातक; Mar. बिब्बा).
आह्वृ €1 P. Ved. To make crooked, injure.

आह्वृत p. p. Injured; ˚भेषज a. curing what is injured
 or bent; Av. 19. 2. 5.

आह्वरकः A low or expelled man (who, after having offered a sacrifice
 to the manes, takes the sacrificial food for himself); अन्नमपहर्तार
 आह्वरका भवन्ति श्राद्धे सिद्धे P. III. 2. 135. Com.
आह्वारकः A recension of the black Yajurveda.

आह्वे €1 P.
—1 To call, summon.
—2 To invite, invoke (in a liturgical sense).
—3 (Ā.) To provoke, challenge; कृष्णश्चाणूरमाह्वयते Sk.; आह्वत
 चेदिराण्मुरारिम् Śi. 20. 1; Bk. 6. 25, 8. 18, 15. 28, 42, 89. ━Caus.
—1 To send for, call; कविमाह्वाययामास प्रस्तुतप्रतिपत्तये R. 15. 75;
 Bk. 6. 121.
—2 To cause to invite or summon.

आह्व a. [आ-ह्वे-ड]
—1 Who or what calls, a crier.
—2 Named, called.

आह्व + .{@-ह्वा@} [आ-ह्वे-अड्]
—1 Calling, calling out.
—2 A name, appellation, oft. at the end of comp.; अमृताह्वः शताह्वा &c.

—1 A name, appellation (as last member of comp.); काव्यं रामायणाह्वयम्
 Rām.; चकसाह्वयम्, चरणाह्वयाः; वृद्धेरप्याह्वया इमे Ak.
—2 A law-suit arising from a dispute about games with animals, as cock-fighting
 &c.; (one of the 18 titles of law); पणपूर्वकपक्षिमेषादियोधनम् आह्वयः
 Rāghavānanda on Ms. 8. 7.

—1 Calling, inviting.
—2 A call, invitation, summons (in general); सुहृदाह्वानं प्रकुर्वीत Pt. 3. 47.
—3 A legal summons (from court or govt. to appear before a tribunal); Mk. 9.
—4 Invocation of a deity; जन्मज्येष्ठेन चाह्वानं सुब्रह्मण्यास्वपि स्मृतम् Ms. 9. 126.
—5 A challenge.
—6 A name, appellation.
—7 N. of a liturgical formula.
.━{@Comp.@}: आह्वानदर्शनम्
आह्वानयति Den. P. (In law) To summon.
आह्वायक + .{@-कः@} A messenger, courier; आह्वायकान् भूमिपतेरयोध्याम् Bk. 2. 43.
